data.body:
Implemented and pushed as Gerrit change 1945 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1945), commit e80b7c597d.

Result: `prompts.py` 789 -> **651** (149 lines of headroom, clear of the gate's 720-line near-cap band); new sibling `src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompt_model.py` at **246** LOC. `.github/module-size-limit.txt` byte-identical to origin/main.

Gates: `make lint` PASS, `make typecheck` PASS (575 files), `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` -> `active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0` (run directly, not via make lint). Prompt-index drift gate clean (`regenerate-index` reproduces index.json byte-identically).

Tests, all UNMODIFIED: tests/unit + tests/golden 11446 passed / 44 skipped / 0 failed; tests/interfaces 1936 passed / 9 skipped / 1 xfailed / 0 failed. tests/interfaces was run explicitly because that is where the sibling config.py split's regression surfaced.

Reference verification, both tools: Serena find_referencing_symbols over the moved symbols, plus an AST sweep of every `from ...prompting.prompts import` in src/tests/scripts (all five moved public names — EXECUTION_MODES, Prompt, PromptNotFound, Reviewer, ReviewerError — are covered by the re-export facade) and a string-literal grep for all fifteen moved names (only hit outside the new seam test is `rebar.llm.__all__`, which imports through prompts). No monkeypatch/getattr/importlib target among them.
